subject: english
stem: A library manager says self-check machines shorten lines. Some older users say staff help is easier for them. Which is a balanced account?
options: Machines may improve speed, while some users prefer personal assistance.

optionRationales.reason: Older users reject every technology.：強度過度。
The manager wants longer lines.：相反。
Machines may improve speed, while some users prefer personal assistance.：保留 may 與 some 的限定。
Machines are perfect for everyone.：忽略 some users。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「兩來源選擇的利益、風險與受影響群體顯示對同一事件的不同觀點」可推出 Machines may improve speed, while some users prefer personal assistance.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Machines may improve speed, while some users prefer personal assistance. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
